name: New in a country
triggers: I just moved to a new country
we arrived last week, what do we do first
I'm a newcomer and nothing works without something else
boundary: Not legal or immigration advice. Rules on residence, work and benefits differ by country and change often; confirm anything decisive with the official authority or a registered adviser.
ask_first: Which country and city, and is anyone's right to stay time-limited? A deadline on a permit changes the order.

steps.why: ID, registration, bank, phone and address unlock each other; doing them in the right order avoids the loops that trap newcomers.
Children lose weeks to the wrong office or a missing paper; start the school place in week one.
Know how to see a doctor before anyone is ill.
carry: registered with a doctor or clinic

steps.why: Credit does not transfer across borders; start building it early.
Getting qualifications recognised takes months; start it before the job search needs it.

done_when: Registered, banked, children in school or applied, a doctor arranged, credit started, and qualifications recognition under way.
